title: Request Forensics Workspace: Correlation Timeline & Span Lens
creator: Asha Iyer
description: Design a focused "Request Forensics Workspace" for the Redwood Console that allows engineers and on-call owners to quickly investigate individual user requests and request classes. The workspace combines a correlation timeline, span-level "lens", and flexible filters (correlation IDs, model, route, region, latency thresholds) so teams can surface root causes, regressions, and performance outliers. This ticket covers the end-to-end UI flows, prototypes, edge-case handling, and handoff artifacts for engineering and PM.
acceptance_criteria: Correlation timeline shows request hops (ingress, routing, model variant, fallback) with time-aligned spans and per-span metadata on hover
Span Lens panel surfaces decoded span attributes (duration, kernel, device, batch size, cache hit/miss, KV cache size) and links to related logs/trace events
Filtering supports quick narrowing by correlation ID, route, model, region, status code, and latency percentile; filters persist across navigation and are bookmarkable via URL params
Aggregation mode that collapses repeated spans into summarized swimlanes while offering an expandable sample list for deep-dive
Performance: timeline rendering remains interactive for up to 2,000 spans (progressive loading and sampling strategies documented)
Prototype available in Figma with desktop and narrow (tablet) layouts and an interactive demo for support and SRE playbook reviews
Design handoff includes tokens, component variants, and accessibility notes (keyboard navigation for timeline, color contrast, screenreader labels)
